race.description: Family Of League Race Day, Sunday 22nd Nov Hcp
race.comment: ALBERTA BOUND (1) gets the nod on a strong fresh profile, with three wins from three starts at this track and distance and a last-campaign Townsville win by four and a half lengths when heavily backed. Ryan Wiggins also knows her well, which adds to the appeal. WORTHY GEM (2) is the immediate danger after winning at this track over 1250m despite being checked, and three wins from four starts at this venue make his form hard to dismiss. BOOMING BELIEF (6) brings a last-start Townsville Mdn win and weight relief, but she was beaten by WORTHY GEM here two runs ago and her 950m record is still winless. Place hope. GOOD ONE CECIL (5) also comes off a Townsville Mdn win and gets the apprentice claim, though he has more to prove against the better-exposed runners. Wider plays.
